notes: ait_ids are the Allen Institute Taxonomy numbers shown on each taxonomy's brain-map.org page; ait_ids_by_species gives the per-species number for multi-species taxonomies.
regions holds anatomical terms only (scripts/ait_taxonomy.py matches them against a paper's regions); cohort or developmental scope goes in context.

Not re-confirmed against brain-map.org on the snapshot date: the AIT106 number for the Whole Human Brain taxonomy, the CCNs of the Aging Mouse Brain and Comparative LGN taxonomies (null), and the per-entry mapmycells flags other than AIT21, AIT31, AIT33, AIT106, the basal ganglia, SEA-AD multiregion and developing visual cortex taxonomies.

taxonomies.title: Whole Mouse Brain Cell Type Taxonomy (AIT21)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 34 classes / 338 subclasses / 1201 supertypes / 5322 clusters (~4M cells; MERFISH registered to CCFv3)

taxonomies.title: Whole Mouse Brain Consensus (AIT33)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 9 neighborhoods / 43 classes / 414 subclasses / 1,386 supertypes / 6,721 clusters; integrates the Allen Institute scRNA-seq (AIT21) and Broad Institute snRNA-seq whole mouse brain taxonomies

taxonomies.title: Aging Mouse Brain Taxonomy
context: aging: young adult (2 months) vs aged (18 months), both sexes
taxonomies.hierarchy: ~1.2M scRNA-seq cells, 847 clusters (at least 14 age-biased, mostly glial); mapped onto WMB class/subclass/supertype
taxonomies.publication: Jin K., Yao Z., van Velthoven C.T.J. et al., Nature 638:182-196 (2025) doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08350-8

taxonomies.title: Developing Mouse Visual Cortex Taxonomy
context: development: E11.5 to P56, 53 donors, wild-type C57BL/6J
taxonomies.publication: A high-resolution transcriptomic and epigenomic cell-type atlas of the developing mouse visual cortex

taxonomies.title: Mouse Isocortex & Hippocampal Formation Taxonomy (AIT5.1)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 388 transcriptomic types (364 neuronal) from ~1.3M cells profiled with 10x and SMART-seq

taxonomies.title: Cross-Species (Consensus) Basal Ganglia Taxonomy (AIT19.5 / 11.9 / 101)
taxonomies.hierarchy: >2M nuclei, 10x multiome + ATAC + spatial + morphology/ephys; ~60 homologous types aligned to mouse and human whole-brain atlases; refined MSN/GABAergic taxonomy
taxonomies.publication: Johansen N.J., Fu Y., Schmitz M. et al., Cross-species consensus atlas of the primate basal ganglia, bioRxiv (2025) doi:10.64898/2025.12.15.694496

taxonomies.title: Whole Human Brain Taxonomy (AIT106)
taxonomies.hierarchy: >3M nuclei from ~100 dissections, 3 donors; 31 superclusters / 461 clusters / 3313 subclusters

taxonomies.title: Human MTG SEA-AD Taxonomy (AIT31)
context: Alzheimer's disease: aged cohort spanning the AD spectrum
taxonomies.hierarchy: ~1.4M QC'd nuclei (~2.0M profiled), 84 aged donors; 3 classes / 24 subclasses / 139 supertypes
taxonomies.publication: Gabitto M.I. & Travaglini K.J. et al., Nat Neurosci (2024) doi:10.1038/s41593-024-01774-5

taxonomies.title: SEA-AD Multiregion Taxonomy
context: Alzheimer's disease: spans the full arc of AD staging
taxonomies.hierarchy: ~7M nuclei (snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, Multiome) from 84 donors across 10 neo- and allocortical regions (MEC, MTG, PFC/A9 in all 84; HIP, LEC, ITG, STG, FI, AnG, V1C in 43); 3 classes / 28 subclasses / 207 supertypes, retaining the SEA-AD MTG types

taxonomies.title: Human Neocortex Taxonomy (AIT105) — Multiple Cortical Areas SMART-seq
taxonomies.hierarchy: 49,495 SMART-seq nuclei across MTG, ACC, V1C, M1C, S1C, A1C; 24 consistent subclasses
taxonomies.publication: Jorstad N.L. et al., Science 382 (2023) doi:10.1126/science.adf6812

taxonomies.title: Human MTG SMART-Seq Taxonomy (AIT15.3)
taxonomies.publication: Hodge R.D., Bakken T.E. et al., Nature 573:61-68 (2019)

taxonomies.title: Mammalian Primary Motor Cortex Taxonomy (BICCN M1)
taxonomies.hierarchy: >3M cells profiled across modalities and species (BICCN flagship)
taxonomies.publication: BICCN, Nature (2021) — Bakken T.E. et al. and companion papers

taxonomies.title: Comparative Lateral Geniculate Nucleus Taxonomy (AIT102/103/104)
taxonomies.hierarchy: Cross-species SMART-seq dLGN taxonomy; 1,209 human nuclei, 2,157 macaque nuclei, 2,190 mouse cells
taxonomies.publication: Bakken T.E., van Velthoven C., Menon V. et al., eLife 10:e64875 (2021)
